top_categories.workout_context: 84ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Houffa Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Houffa Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
Houffa Gravel's Belgian Ardennes lap race, UCI Gravel World Series forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 86 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Houffa Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
At mile 60 of 86, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
7,185ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
7,185ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 86 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Houffa Gravel, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 86 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 7,185ft of climbing on belgian Ardennes gravel — 46km lap circuit does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Houffa Gravel’s 86 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Houffa Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on belgian ardennes gravel — 46km lap circuit to build confidence. Expect: belgian ardennes lap race, uci gravel world series, côte de saint roch opener.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and G Spot to prepare you for 86 miles of belgian ardennes gravel — 46km lap circuit in Houffalize, Belgian Ardennes.
